source_clause: ICE8.) Rear Defrost has on/ off state. Gray out the REAR DEFROST button when rear defrost availability status from CCM denotes that .
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.9（ICE8）以兩句定出 Rear Defrost 之 on/off 狀態與 CCM 可用性之灰化，兩個 037 leaf 對應之。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值；**第十軸（REAR DEFROST 有無，出處 3.4）**兩條全補；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：狀態與灰化之觸發不同（按鍵 vs CCM 狀態），可獨立失效。刻意略過：**ICE8 僅兩句，不含 C8 之「independent of any other climate functions」與鏡面除霜之連動** —— 批次 10 之 `013-03`／`013-04` 已因此得 `no`；本節不驗該二者，亦不得反向以 C8 補之（§8.2.1）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第九軸「EMEA ICS 車型」之值（介面型，R-C34）
distinguishing_axis.delta: `2.9` 取**非 ICS** 值（ch2 之 climate screen），`16.9` 取 **ICS** 值（ch16 之 ICS climate screen）。**兩節之 TC 於 `test_item`／`test_procedure`／`expected_result` 三欄逐字相同**（`013-01`≡`114-01`、`013-02`≡`114-02`，見 pending_sibling 之 `equivalent_tc_pairs`），其唯一差異在 `pre_conditions` 之軸值 —— 此即 §10.6 所謂「另有可區辨之情境條件」，故 **`duplicate_of` 不填**；惟 `2.9` 尚有 `013-03`（獨立性）與 `013-04`（鏡面除霜連動）二條為 ICE8 所無，兩側不等勢

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen 之 REAR DEFROST 按鈕（含灰化）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— ch16 十八節無 tab 條文
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 本節屬 ch16，取**正向**軸值 PC（出處 16.2）

tcs.tc_title: Rear Defrost has an on and off state
tcs.test_item:
ICE8.) Rear Defrost has on/ off state.

(press "REAR DEFROST" again -> The "REAR DEFROST" button is no longer highlighted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with rear defrost, which is absent on some soft top vehicles (3.4)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "REAR DEFROST" on the climate screen
2. Press "REAR DEFROST" again
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "REAR DEFROST" button is highlighted
2. The "REAR DEFROST" button is no longer highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: Rear Defrost shall have an on/off state

tcs.tc_title: Rear Defrost greys out when the CCM reports it unavailable
tcs.test_item:
Gray out the REAR DEFROST button when rear defrost availability status from CCM denotes that .

(read the "REAR DEFROST" button on the climate screen -> The "REAR DEFROST" button is greyed out)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with rear defrost, which is absent on some soft top vehicles (3.4)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the rear defrost availability status from the CCM to unavailable
2. Read the "REAR DEFROST" button on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen is displayed
2. The "REAR DEFROST" button is greyed out
